svg.title: Pioneer CDJ Emulator — a growing family of players
svg.desc: Actual emulator screenshots: supported CDJ-2000NXS2, experimental CDJ-2000, CDJ-2000NXS, XDJ-1000, XDJ-700 and CDJ-900NXS. Older decks run below real time and have no sound. XDJ-1000MK2 is in development.
svg.metadata: Original emulator captures, arranged without altering the firmware interface. Individual screenshots are available in the README gallery. This is an independent project, not affiliated with Pioneer DJ or AlphaTheta.

g.text: Actual emulator captures · Older decks: experimental, below real time, no sound
